name: Suluk
contribution: A Türgesh tribal leader and a Qaghan who defended Transoxiana against Umayyad conquest in the early 8th century.

checks.lead: Suluk, Sul-lu or Sulu (?-738) was a Türgesh tribal leader and a Qaghan who defended Transoxiana against Umayyad conquest in the early 8th century.
